users.duplicateHint: They get {{name}}'s role, language and maximum discount, with their own name and PIN.

roles.duplicateHint: The new role gets the same permissions; you can change them afterwards.

hourly.label: Hourly copies while the till is open
hourly.hint: One copy an hour while a cash session is open on this PC; beyond the number chosen, the day's oldest are removed.

dayCutoff.label: Business day changes at
dayCutoff.hint: Sales made before this hour count for the previous day (never for the previous year).

keys.title: Till keys
keys.intro: Every action of the sale screen has its key: an F key (except F11, kept for the scale), Ctrl + a digit, or {{escape}}.

till.title: Payment at the till
till.intro: Choose whether the cashier picks how each customer pays, or the till always takes the same method.

modeHints.ask: Pay (F12) opens the payment window with the methods ticked below.
modeHints.fixed: Pay (F12) or Enter finishes the sale at once for the exact amount, without the payment window.

till.methodHint: Cheque, transfer, customer credit and store credit need details or a customer: they stay in the payment window.
till.allowedHint: When some methods are unticked, the first ticked one opens with the exact amount: Enter validates. A payment type shows with the method it counts as.
till.typeGone: The payment type chosen is no longer available. Cash is shown: save to confirm, or choose another method.

types.title: Payment types
types.intro: Extra payment buttons for the till. Each one is counted as one of the usual methods (for example, a CCP direct debit counted as a transfer).
types.codeHint: Lowercase letters without accents, digits and _ (24 at most).
types.codeInvalid: Lowercase letters, digits and _ only (1 to 24).
types.empty: No extra payment type. The usual methods stay at the till.

qr.title: BaridiMob QR (BaridPay)
qr.intro: The customer screen shows this QR when BaridiMob payment is chosen.
qr.hint: The text of your BaridPay merchant QR (10 to 512 characters).
qr.invalid: The text must have 10 to 512 characters.
qr.none: No QR: the customer screen shows none.

regulatory.title: Regulatory pack
regulatory.intro: VAT rates, the stamp duty scale, regulated prices, the zakat rate and the wilayas come from a file signed by DZBuild (the shop enters the nisab itself, on the Zakat screen). A new pack is installed from a USB stick and applies at the next start.
regulatory.installedEmpty: No pack installed: the software uses the one it ships with.
regulatory.installHint: Choose the pack's .json file, then its .sig file (DZBuild's signature). A pack without DZBuild's signature is refused.
regulatory.done: Installed: it will apply at the next start.

modes.rawHint: The software sends the ticket to the printer, Arabic included.
modes.driverHint: For a printer that refuses direct printing: the ticket prints as a page through Windows.

kitchen.title: Kitchen printers
kitchen.hint: Each preparation station prints its tickets on the chosen printer; without one, on the fallback printer, else on the receipt printer. A network kitchen printer serves every till.
kitchen.noPrinter: First add a printer on the “Receipt printers” tab.
kitchen.noStation: No preparation station: create them in Restaurant › Preparation stations.
